_note: The FRIENDS' moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: best_friend (from school, not an athlete), friend (1-2 more, each with a trait: gamer, musician, artist, joker, scout, partygoer, old_team = from the athlete's old sport), friends (any). Session L3a (the sort, docs/L3_SORT.md, user 2026-10-25): real Finnish teenage life that competes for your free time comes as INVITATIONS into a free-time slot (Go / Stay home with the visible price: a late night before a race or a hard session, the friendship); the rest are FEED messages that ask nothing; the best friend's 'you never have time' is a STORY BEAT whose 'Saturday, just us' takes this Saturday's slot. Invitation texts are written for a day ahead ('on {weekday}'), never 'tonight'. Standing orders: party_before_race, weekend_party, school_night, test_evening. Ages 14-16 (P2 adds 16-17).

text: Serious question: why do you run in circles for fun. I respect it. I don't get it, but I respect it.
So you're an athlete now. Like, properly. Don't forget us normal people.

invite.title: A party the night before your race?

text: Party at Joonas's place on {weekday}! His parents are away. Everyone's going. You're coming, right?
{weekday} night at the beach, a bonfire, the whole class. Come on, just for a bit!

text.text: There's a party on {weekday} and you're the only one who hasn't answered. Coming?

replies.label: I race the next day, sorry
replies.rule: Always say no to parties the night before a race
replies.result: Boring. Good luck tomorrow, I guess.

replies.label: An hour, then home
replies.hint: a late night before a race
replies.result: You left at ten like Cinderella. Everyone noticed. In a good way.

replies.label: I'm in!
replies.hint: a very late night before a race
replies.result: You got home at one. The party was legendary. Tomorrow may not be.

text: Movie night at mine on {weekday}. Pizza, horror films, nobody sleeps. Coming?
Everyone's going bowling on {weekday} and then to the kiosk. You in?

text.text: Sauna evening at our place on {weekday}, then we watch the game. You have to come.

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: Best night in ages, and a late one.

replies.label: I'll come, but leave early
replies.rule: Go to weekend evenings, but leave early
replies.result: Better than nothing!

replies.label: Stay home: training the next day
replies.rule: Say no to weekend evenings before a long or hard session
replies.result: You and your long runs.

text: New season starts on {weekday}. Online at nine? We need you on the team.
We're one player short on {weekday}. Just a couple of rounds. You in?

replies.label: Couple of rounds, then bed
replies.result: "Couple of rounds" ended at midnight. As always.

replies.label: Not on a school night
replies.result: Noob.

text: Our band plays at the youth centre on {weekday}! Our first real gig. You HAVE to come.
Gig on {weekday} at the school concert. I'm doing a solo. Will you be there?

replies.label: Wouldn't miss it
replies.result: You were the loudest one in the crowd, and home late. Thank you!

replies.label: I'll stay home
replies.result: OK. I get it. Sort of.

text: I drew you running. Don't laugh. The legs are a bit long: artistic freedom.
I'm making a comic about our class. You're the superhero who runs really fast.
Scout hike on {weekday}: a night in a tent by the lake, no phones. Come along as a guest?
We're building a lean-to shelter in the forest on {weekday}, then a night out there. Need someone with legs that don't get tired.

replies.label: Sounds great
replies.result: A tent, a lake, very little sleep. The trails were amazing.

replies.label: Not this time
replies.result: Next time, then.

text: We play the final on {weekday}! Come and watch, the old {old_sport} team wants to see you.
The summer tournament final is on {weekday}. The team misses you. Come and watch?

replies.label: I'll come and watch
replies.result: You cheered louder than the parents.

replies.label: I can't, sorry
replies.result: OK. Good luck with the running thing.

text: I saw your time! I don't understand it, but everyone says it's good. Congrats!!
Personal best! Teach me how to be good at something.
Heard it didn't go well. Whatever. You're still the fastest person I know.
Bad race. Ice cream is on me next time.
You never have time any more. Training, training, training. Are we still friends?
Everyone went to the cinema without you again. Not because we don't like you. You just never come.

replies.label: You're right. Saturday, just us
replies.result: Saturday. No excuses.

replies.label: It's important to me
replies.result: I know. I just miss you.

replies.label: You don't understand
replies.result: Maybe I don't.

text: I need advice. There's someone in 9B. I think I'm going to say something. Wish me luck.
My parents are fighting all the time. I don't want to be at home much. Just so you know.
{test_subject} test on {tomorrow}. Study together on {weekday} evening? My place, I have snacks.
Panic. {test_subject} on {tomorrow}. Video call on {weekday} and go through it together?

replies.label: Yes, let's do it
replies.result: We actually got through it. Mostly.

replies.label: I'll keep my evening
replies.rule: Say no to study evenings with friends
replies.result: Fine, genius.

text: Happy Friendship Day! Here's a heart emoji. Don't make it weird.
Ystävänpäivä! You're my best friend. Even with all the running.
Vappu on {weekday}! Picnic in the park, balloons, munkki and sima. Coming?
Vappu in the town square on {weekday}. Everyone will be there. Coming?

replies.label: Of course!
replies.result: Sima, doughnuts, everyone in silly hats. A perfect vappu.

replies.label: Not this year
replies.result: Who skips vappu?

invite.title: The beach after the spring party?

text: SUMMER! We're going to the beach after the spring party on {weekday}. Coming?
Last day of school on {weekday}! Ice cream, the beach, the whole class. You can't say no.

replies.label: Yes! Summer!
replies.result: Cold water, warm sun, ten weeks of freedom.

replies.label: I'll pass
replies.result: The beach isn't going anywhere. Neither are we.

text: Fireworks on the hill on New Year's Eve. Everyone's going. Coming?
New Year's Eve at Emilia's. Her parents are cool. Midnight on the roof terrace!

replies.label: I'm coming
replies.result: Happy new year! Best fireworks yet, and a late night.

replies.label: I'm with my family
replies.result: OK. Happy new year in advance!

text: The class pikkujoulu is on {weekday}! Secret Santa, max 5 euros. You're coming?
Pre-Christmas party at the youth centre on {weekday}. Dress code: ugly Christmas sweater.

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: You got socks with reindeer on them, and home late. Perfect.

replies.label: I'll skip it
replies.result: Your Secret Santa gift is waiting at school.

text: So you're injured. Bad news for you, good news for me: now you have time! Film night on {weekday}?
I could come over on {weekday} and we play something. You don't need legs for that.

replies.label: Please, I'm so bored
replies.result: Snacks, and the second controller.

replies.label: I'd rather be alone
replies.result: OK. Text me when you're bored of being alone.

text: Camp food is terrible and the lake is freezing. Best week of the summer.
The isoset are cool and the lake is freezing. A whole week of no parents.
I hope we end up at the same school. Just saying.
If you go to a sports school far away, I'm coming to visit. Every holiday.
So it's decided. Congrats! I'm happy for you. And sad. Both.
You got in! Whatever happens, you're still my best friend.
My birthday party is on {weekday}! A sleepover, pizza and films until morning. Coming?
{weekday}: birthday sleepover at mine. You can't miss it, I'm only turning fifteen once.

replies.label: Wouldn't miss it
replies.result: Nobody slept. Best birthday ever, apparently.

replies.label: I can't this time
replies.result: Oh. OK.

text: Swimming hall on {weekday}? The new slide is open. And the sauna.
{weekday} swim? Mostly the slides and the hot tub, not real swimming.

replies.label: Yes, slides!
replies.result: Two hours of slides and sauna.

replies.label: I'll stay home
replies.result: Your loss. The slide is amazing.

text: Half a metre of snow! Sledding on the big hill on {weekday}? Bring the sledge.
Snow fort at the park on {weekday}. We need someone to carry snow fast. You're perfect.

replies.label: Coming!
replies.result: Cold cheeks, wet gloves, a lot of laughing.

replies.label: Not this time
replies.result: The hill will still be there.

invite.title: Ice cream at the harbour on {weekday}?

text: Ice cream at the harbour on {weekday}? It's light until midnight anyway.
Beach on {weekday} evening? Someone's bringing a speaker.

replies.label: I'll be there
replies.result: The sun never really set. Neither did the talking. A late night.

replies.label: For an hour
replies.result: One hour. You actually left on time. Impressive.

replies.label: Not this time
replies.result: Boo. OK.

text: I'm freaking out about the application. My average is too low for the school I want. Study together on {weekday}?
Everyone else seems to know what they want to be. I have no idea. Can we study together on {weekday} and talk?

replies.label: Let's study together
replies.result: Deal. My place.

replies.label: I can't that evening
replies.result: OK. Another time.

text: The new film comes out on {weekday}. Cinema? I'll buy the popcorn.
Cinema on {weekday}? Something stupid with explosions.

replies.label: Yes!
replies.result: Terrible film. Great evening.

replies.label: Next time
replies.result: You always say next time.
